description: Both variants delete the SAME statement (`y = y + 5;`). Completes the convergent family: convergent_edit pins the identical *edit*, convergent_insert the identical *insertion* (which HPR must reject, since two independently added statements have no counterpart to be identified through), and this pins the identical *deletion* - which HPR handles correctly, because a deletion is the absence of a counterpart on the Base side and both variants agree on that absence. Clean, and the merged program is the program both developers wrote.
